newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Liberty to change name, purpose after buy-in.
newsitem.headline: Liberty to change name, purpose after buy-in.

text.p: Liberty Mines Inc said on Thursday its board had approved a resolution changing its name to Philcomsat Holdings Corp after the buy-in by the telecommunications firm.
Corporate secretary Roberto San Jose told the Philippine Stock Exchange it would change its primary purpose to holding company from the present mining company.
The Philippine Communications Satellite Corp bought about 16 percent of Liberty in July.
The board had also agreed to increase its authorised capital to up to 5.0 billion pesos, and change its par value to one peso per share from one centavo.
The resolutions are to be approved by stockholders at a meeting set on January 10 next year.
